# Januario Pinto

> Software developer and consultant in Lisbon. Designs organizations as living systems and the software that runs on them. Founder of The Unit Organization, an incubator and studio.

## Services
- Software development: web platforms, internal tools, AI features and automation. A working product, not a prototype.
- Consulting: strategy, technology and organization. Fractional CTO without the cost of a full-time hire. Distributed systems that don't rely on the founder. Self-managing teams (Teal, Holacracy).
- Ventures: companies built from the ground up, incubated and funded through The Unit Organization.

## Public portfolio
- People: the platform for self-managing teams.
- Flows: business automations the business can read.
- Artist OS: websites and tools for musicians, on their own domain.

## Current work (with clients; described, not linked)
- A restaurant platform: point of sale, a WhatsApp ordering bot, an ordering website, delivery through transport-partner API integrations, cloud sales dashboards.
- A clinic platform: CRM for a medical practice with AI-drafted reports for doctors.
- Holacracy tooling: an AI assistant for self-management, used by teams in practice.
